O.outcome_detail: correct identification of saturation versus breakdown in magnetization

cells.quote: The vast majority of student responses included only super-atomic resources to describe and explain magnetization and its effect on the material. These resources consisted mainly of alignment of atoms in some sense. Only two students did not reach the correct answer of saturation, and interestingly, those students used sub-atomic resources in their responses. Those students mentioned the internal structure of the atom during magnetization, and they concluded with breakdown of the material.
cells.note: Students had been taught concepts about magnetic fields and magnetization before the final exam; the comparison is observational rather than an instructional manipulation.

cells.quote: "Students in high-comfort groups had higher final exam scores (average = 72.2%) than others (average = 66.1%) (p = 0.011, Student’s t-test [36])."
